headline: Sensex and Nifty face volatility as IT stocks drag; SpiceJet under DGCA scrutiny while NSE IPO sees strong demand

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: IT stocks dragged the market down in the previous session, leading to a 330-point fall in the Sensex
The DGCA is conducting operational and financial checks on SpiceJet
The NSE IPO received a strong 6x subscription on its final day of bidding
CCI has cleared Fairfax India's proposal to acquire an additional stake in IIFL Capital Services
whatHappening: Nifty ended below the 23,350 mark following a negative bias in the broader market
Swan Defence announced plans to hire 550 additional employees by March 2027
Samsung India reported a 36% decline in FY26 profit due to rising royalties and falling export revenue
Global cues including US inflation risks and Asian market signals are impacting Indian market sentiment
summary: The Indian stock market is experiencing volatility with the Nifty slipping below 23,350, pressured by a sell-off in the IT sector. Regulatory scrutiny is a key focus as the DGCA investigates SpiceJet, while the primary market shows strength with the NSE IPO being oversubscribed. Investors are also monitoring corporate developments including CCI approvals for IIFL Capital Services and hiring expansions at Swan Defence.
